BUILDPLAN notes: Serialized on `justfile` (`a11y`)

Workflow mode: fast-track. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

data.body: DISPATCHED PQ-16 2026-09-29 23:4x EDT by the Orchestrator: fast-track, surface:12 in pane:1, worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/a11y-sweep, branch ai-c11-cc/a11y-sweep off origin/main @ 1263add270aafbb5cc087c3e7c94981c5f17c9fd. Boot prompt at the worktree's .claude/boot-prompt.md (templates/gen-wave17.py). Rulings in the brief: (1) AC-84's dim-room clause has no built presentation (lights up, no dark mode in v1, touchpoint T-16; F-37 routed upstream) - prove AA on the one presentation and record the clause under deviations, build no dim mode; (2) just a11y is a node suite on the existing runner with no dependency, run from test-full per EVALUATION and from test too if hermetic and fast; PENDING drops a11y:T-13 (the PQ-20 shape); what a layout-less stub cannot prove is a once-by-hand c11 browser pass written into web/README.md for the validator; (3) no new copy - a state change in AC-83's list with no SPEC section 11 string is a QUESTION on this ticket, never a string; (4) web/shared/tokens.css, components.css and dom.js are cleared additively, a colour token value change needs a ruling by comment first; room/** is read-only. No sibling this wave; PQ-26 and PQ-27 press ahead off your branch once you are at review, so keep the justfile change to the a11y lines. Push and gh pr create are the client's Yes in your tab.
